route_family_policies.capture_policy: Record local source existence, source-object existence, index membership, SQL or NumericFact execution, candidate-pool membership, rank and admission state with exact digests.
route_family_policies.fallback: Repair the earliest failing local S1 layer before any external acquisition or ranking experiment.
route_family_policies.stop_condition: Stop the route when the proposition is already answered by admitted Evidence or when an unresolved local binding/index/SQL defect owns the failure.

route_family_policies.capture_policy: Capture original issuer or regulator material first, including publisher, title, speaker, date, period, page or section, locator and citation rights.
route_family_policies.fallback: Use the issuer filing, prepared remarks, presentation or regulator archive in that order; never substitute a search snippet for the original.
route_family_policies.stop_condition: Stop after the mandatory official families are captured or a receipt proves non-disclosure for the bounded proposition and period.

route_family_policies.capture_policy: Capture original customer filing, procurement notice, deployment case or executive statement with the customer as evidence owner.
route_family_policies.fallback: Retain the customer fact as context only if a Dell relationship bridge cannot be established.
route_family_policies.stop_condition: Stop if no named relationship is evidenced or if the customer-owned fact cannot materially support or limit a DELL report claim.

route_family_policies.capture_policy: Capture original supplier filing, prepared remarks, capacity schedule or product availability statement with direction and period.
route_family_policies.fallback: Retain supplier disclosure as industry context and preserve Dell allocation as an open boundary.
route_family_policies.stop_condition: Stop before inferring Dell allocation, yield, shipment or economics from supplier-wide capacity or revenue.

route_family_policies.capture_policy: Capture the original methodology, denominator, geography, calendar period and vendor definition together with the industry measure.
route_family_policies.fallback: Use the measure only as a typed estimate or context when Dell company-level mapping is unavailable.
route_family_policies.stop_condition: Stop when the denominator, period or company mapping is incompatible with the target proposition.

route_family_policies.capture_policy: Capture exact configuration, quote date, quantity, included components, service terms, deployment unit and buyer context.
route_family_policies.fallback: Keep observations as configuration examples or scenario inputs; never promote them to company-wide ASP or units.
route_family_policies.stop_condition: Stop when configurations are not comparable or when the sample cannot support a defined denominator and period.

route_family_policies.capture_policy: Capture a traceable original or trusted report with named sources, date, proposition polarity and explicit separation from target-company fact.
route_family_policies.fallback: Use only to locate an original or to frame a bounded counter-scenario.
route_family_policies.stop_condition: Stop when the context lacks an original lineage, duplicates an existing route, or would be used as Dell-owned fact.

nodes.runtime_profile: Existing BM25 plus 0.6B dense retrieval; no execution in 03A.

TokenBudgetBasis.node_purpose: Establish the current candidate ceiling and reproducible baseline.
TokenBudgetBasis.input_scale: Only bounded proposition queries and the frozen source-object corpus.
TokenBudgetBasis.required_outputs: Target-in-pool, semantic-equivalent coverage, rank and per-case regression receipts.
TokenBudgetBasis.schema_burden: Per-query candidate IDs, route membership, ranks and digests.
TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_and_quality_risk: A false ceiling diagnosis can waste external calls or hide a retrieval defect.
TokenBudgetBasis.comparable_run_evidence: Current S1 candidate packet and prior DELL/MU/NVDA retrieval results.
TokenBudgetBasis.reasoning_profile: Embedding inference only; no generative decision authority.
TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Stop on missing target pool, corpus drift, resource failure or any case regression.

nodes.runtime_profile: 4-bit 4B embedding model loaded alone on the 8GB GPU after an empirical memory probe; no execution in 03A.

TokenBudgetBasis.node_purpose: Test material recall or ranking gain over the 0.6B baseline without replacing it by assertion.
TokenBudgetBasis.input_scale: The exact same bounded queries and candidate corpus as the baseline.
TokenBudgetBasis.required_outputs: Per-query recall, semantic-equivalent coverage, rank deltas, latency, peak VRAM and no-case-regression receipts.
TokenBudgetBasis.schema_burden: Same candidate identity and metric schema as baseline plus resource telemetry.
TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_and_quality_risk: Larger embeddings may improve semantic matching but can add irrelevant context or fail operationally on 8GB VRAM.
TokenBudgetBasis.comparable_run_evidence: Must compare against the frozen 0.6B baseline on DELL, MU and NVDA.
TokenBudgetBasis.reasoning_profile: Embedding inference only; 4-bit shadow execution and no admission authority.
TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Stop on OOM, model swap contamination, candidate drift, all gains being irrelevant context, or any material case regression.

nodes.runtime_profile: 4-bit reranker loaded separately only after target-in-pool is proved; no execution in 03A.

TokenBudgetBasis.node_purpose: Improve ordering among an already adequate candidate pool.
TokenBudgetBasis.input_scale: Only the preregistered top-N candidate set from each bounded query.
TokenBudgetBasis.required_outputs: NDCG or MRR-style ranking metrics, material top-k hit rate, cross-case regression and resource receipts.
TokenBudgetBasis.schema_burden: Exact query-candidate pairs, scores, ranks, labels and immutable evaluation split.
TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_and_quality_risk: A reranker cannot repair missing candidates and may over-rank fluent but non-authoritative context.
TokenBudgetBasis.comparable_run_evidence: Only runs after baseline and 4B embedding candidate-ceiling receipts are frozen.
TokenBudgetBasis.reasoning_profile: Pairwise or listwise ranking only; no Evidence or report decision authority.
TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Do not start when target-in-pool fails; stop below the preregistered floor, on case regression, OOM or unacceptable latency.
